label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Playoff
items.text: Joaquin Niemann won a playoff over Talor Gooch at LIV Golf Korea, earning his eighth LIV title, the most since 2022, stabilizing the league amid Saudi PIF funding ending after 2026.

items.headline: DeChambeau’s Crowd-Pulling Chaos
items.text: Talor Gooch highlighted Bryson DeChambeau’s combination of social media presence and outstanding driving as a "whole different animal" that draws massive galleries worldwide.
